item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single authoritative 2024 source that maps Sharif’s whole ruling network end-to-end. The evidence is fragmented across IMF program documents, Radio Pakistan announcements, cabinet reporting, and rights reporting. There is also little direct proof of disciplined party machinery beyond coalition bargaining and cabinet formation. The best-supported reading is that Sharif mobilized the state effectively in select domains, but the mobilization was PM-centered and uneven, not a fully consolidated governing machine.","evidence":[{"title":"Pakistan’s largest parties strike deal on coalition government","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-02-21","url":"https://theprint.in/world/pakistans-largest-parties-strike-deal-on-coalition-government/1973213/","summary":"After a hung election, PML-N and PPP struck a governing deal rather than collapsing into stalemate. This is a concrete delivery reform that mobilizes the state into rule-based implementation.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"PM relieves finance minister from key economic forum","publisher":"Dawn","date":"2024-06-15","url":"https://www.dawn.com/news/1839967/pm-shehbaz-relieves-finance-minister-from-key-economic-forum","summary":"Sharif took personal control of ECNEC rather than fully delegating to the technocrat finance minister.
